definition.heading: What is Pancreatic Cancer?
definition.content: Pancreatic cancer occurs when abnormal cells grow uncontrollably in the pancreas, an organ that helps digest food and regulate blood sugar. These cells may form a tumour and spread to nearby organs or other parts of the body.

actionable_insights.heading: Actionable Insights for Your Health
items: Avoid smoking and maintain a healthy weight to support pancreatic health.
Include vegetables, fruits, and whole grains in your meals, and stay physically active.
Report persistent upper abdominal pain, unexplained weight loss, or yellowing of the skin to your doctor.
